# StreamKit+ Documentation

> User guides for streamers and integration addon API (manifest, sandbox globals, permissions, addon categories). Documentation for StreamKit+ v1.2.3.

## Web documentation

- [Documentation home](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/): language picker and current version
- [English documentation](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/index.html): table of contents (English)

## For streamers

- [Getting started](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/user-getting-started.html): First launch, license, what each module is
- [Main window](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/user-main-window.html): Timer, quick actions, title bar, status
- [Latest events](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/user-events.html): Live event feed and replay chips
- [Chat window](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/user-chat.html): Combined chat, sending replies, appearance
- [Settings](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/user-settings.html): Sidebar, save/reset, Main and Interface
- [Addons and catalog](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/user-addons.html): Install platforms, permissions, updates
- [Overlay](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/user-overlay.html): Effects on screen and in OBS
- [Widgets and applications](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/user-widgets.html): OBS widgets and in-app windows
- [Donation timer](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/user-timer.html): Countdown files and auto rules
- [Sound effects](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/user-sounds.html): Alert sounds on events
- [Hotkeys](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/user-hotkeys.html): Keyboard agent and presets
- [Cooperative sync](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/user-coop-sync.html): Share overlay and hotkeys with other PCs
- [Game integrations](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/user-games.html): Viewer actions inside a game
- [Text to speech](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/user-tts.html): Piper, ElevenLabs, Windows voices
- [LLM Access](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/user-llm.html): AI profiles for addons
- [License and updates](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/user-license.html): License, app updates, changelog
- [Backups](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/user-backup.html): Zip snapshots and restore

## For addon developers

- [Getting started](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/getting-started.html): Architecture, installation, project layout, `@rocketman-streamkit/addon-generator`
- [Lifecycle](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/lifecycle.html): How addons are loaded, restarted, and crash-loop protection
- [manifest.json](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/manifest.html): Manifest fields, types, and validation rules
- [Publishing and releases](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/publishing.html): Catalog registration, GitHub release layout, caching, and version sync
- [TypeScript setup](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/typescript.html): `tsconfig.json`, typings, build output
- [Permissions](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/permissions.html): Capability flags and user approval
- [Settings schema](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/settings-schema.html): `GenerateConfig()` and settings UI
- [Localization](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/localization.html): Per-locale strings in addon code
- [Security](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/security.html): Network restrictions, tokens, sandbox limits
- [OAuth and secrets](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/oauth-and-secrets.html): Token exchange via outbound HTTP (no built-in auth server API)

## Sandbox API

- [API overview](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/api-overview.html): All globals at a glance
- [events](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/api-events.html): Event bus and HTTP handler binding
- [network](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/api-network.html): HTTP client, endpoints, WebSocket, SSE, SignalR, Socket.IO
- [api.config & storage](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/api-config-storage.html): Params, app config, private file storage
- [File access](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/api-file-access.html): User-approved read/write to specific paths (`files` API)
- [Text-to-speech (`tts`)](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/api-tts.html): Play messages via the user's TTS engine (`TTS` permission)
- [LLM Access (`llm`)](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/api-llm.html): Chat completions via user LLM profiles (`LLM` permission)
- [yt-dlp downloads (`ytdlp`)](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/api-ytdlp.html): Download media via bundled yt-dlp (`FILE_ACCESS` + `NETWORK_REQUEST`)
- [addons (RPC)](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/api-addons-rpc.html): Addon-to-addon requests and events
- [dashboard](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/api-dashboard.html): Events widget, chat, overlay triggers
- [status, notify, ui](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/api-status-notify-ui.html): Status bar, viewer count, notifications, OAuth result pages
- [Alerts (`alerts`)](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/api-alerts.html): Cross-addon alert display coordination (no permission)
- [Currency](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/api-currency.html): User's primary currency and amount conversion
- [Language detection (`language`)](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/api-language.html): Detect text language via fastText (~176 languages; no permission)
- [Utilities](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/api-utilities.html): Timers, crypto, console, developer mode

## Addon categories

- [Platform addons](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/types-platform.html): `platform.streaming`, `platform.donation`
- [Overlay addons](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/types-overlay.html): Effects, static web, simple media
- [Widget addons](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/types-widget.html): Persistent web pages and OBS sources
- [Application addons](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/types-application.html): In-app sandboxed windows
- [Game addons](https://rocketman-streamkit.github.io/types/en/types-game.html): In-game effects and input triggers

## AI assistants (Context7)

- Library ID: `/rocketman-streamkit/types`
- Registry: https://context7.com/rocketman-streamkit/types
- Use with Context7 MCP (`resolve-library-id` / `query-docs`) or the chat widget on the docs site

## Other StreamKit+ versions

- [Version branches](https://github.com/RocketMan-StreamKit/types/branches): one Git branch per app release — open the branch matching your `app_version`
